description: Encode and decode messages with the Vigenère polyalphabetic cipher using your own keyword.

faqs.a: Each letter is shifted by the corresponding keyword letter (A=0 … Z=25), repeating the keyword across the message.
Use letters only — digits and spaces are ignored. A longer, less predictable keyword is stronger.
Letter case and punctuation are preserved; only A–Z letters are transformed.

howto: Enter your message and a keyword (letters only).
title: Vigenère Cipher Tool
